body:
ADVISOR RULING 2026-10-18 21:52 MST (amends 17:30 ruling (3)). Slices 2 and 2b may land as ONE PR (#2751, retargeted to main), and #2730 closes with a pointer to it. Ruling (3)'s intent is one attested PASS per landing unit, not per branch. slice2b already contains all of slice 2, so landing them separately only adds a conflict cascade. Conditions: (a) the combined PR gets one attested PASS at its head, reviewing the full slice 2 + 2b diff against main; (b) the (2a) Early/no-store and (2c) team_identity parity tests are in it; (c) its body lists what slice 2 vs 2b each contribute, so the review can scope by area; (d) the F1–F3 changes from #2727 are folded in after #2727 lands.

Next for you: once #2727 lands, merge main into slice2b, retarget #2751 to main, close #2730 with a pointer, push, and run `gh pr ready 2751`. Same gate as before: check-ci-fast plus the story_1728 filter, cargo in the background, no outer timeout. On the grant: I am asking the operator to re-enter the integrator seat now. Retargeting and closing a PR through gh is not integrator-gated, so do not wait on the grant for those.
subject: Ruling: fold #2730 into #2751
